summary.text: Alexandra Duarte is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jaron Brandon in a race with no incumbent.
Her campaign website describes her as a farmer and mother.

paragraphs.text: Alexandra Duarte says on her campaign website that she and her husband, John, built their life on the family farm in Modesto, where they raised their children and grew almonds and walnuts.
She says she is running to lower the price of gas, groceries and insurance.
